research_question: Does same-day broker-branch gross participation concentration provide incremental cross-sectional ranking information beyond the frozen HENGCE controls MOM20, REV5, LIQ20, aggregate institutional flow, and frozen S5 market state?

after_freeze_forbidden: change feature sign because of outcome
change broker set or select named branches
drop controls because they weaken the broker coefficient
switch from concentration to participation/directional feature to rescue the result
reinterpret branch as beneficial owner or smart money
upgrade historical reconstruction to strict vendor-PIT

source_and_sample.signal_dates: Every date from 2021-06-30 onward for which the frozen PIT U100 exists, frozen S5 state is known, event-date broker feature and all controls pass lineage/missingness rules, and the forward outcome is mature.
source_and_sample.universe: Frozen date-correct electronics PIT U100: valid current close; >=18 valid turnover observations in last 20 sessions; LIQ20=median turnover; 20 valid corporate-action-safe daily returns; rank LIQ20 desc and ticker asc; first 100.
source_and_sample.unknown_state_policy: Exclude UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED dates and report count.

timing_and_outcomes.primary_stock_outcome: For each stock i in U100, use the same next-open corporate-action-safe simple H20 return geometry already frozen by Selection Challenge. Cross-sectional percentile ranking of this H20 return is the model outcome.
timing_and_outcomes.u100_excess_equivalence_note: Subtracting same-date U100_H20 from every stock does not change within-date ranks; the primary rank outcome is therefore equivalent for ranking purposes.
timing_and_outcomes.cost_role: Primary rank regression is not a portfolio and therefore does not apply a constant portfolio cost. Any secondary or later portfolio comparison must inherit 40 bp round-trip with no change.
timing_and_outcomes.latest_maturity_rule: Do not use a signal date until the full prespecified horizon outcome is observable.

primary_predictor.raw_orientation: higher = more concentrated gross broker participation

MOM20.definition: Sum of 20 corporate-action-safe log price-path returns ending on d, using the currently frozen Selection Challenge implementation.

REV5.definition: Prior-5-session close-to-close return; use the frozen N2 baseline definition without alteration.

LIQ20.definition: Median turnover over the latest 20 TWSE trading sessions ending on d, requiring at least 18 valid turnover observations.

AGG_FLOW5.definition: stock_totalnet_intensity_5(s,t) = sum(TotalNet[s,d], last 5 eligible sessions) / sum(Volume[s,d], same sessions).
AGG_FLOW5.missingness: Missing institutional evidence is NULL, never zero-filled; no calendar-day forward fill.

S5_STATE.primary_control_geometry: The primary model is estimated separately within each signal date, so all same-date market-wide state effects are absorbed by the date-specific intercept. State-stratified broker-slope diagnostics are additionally reported but do not define the primary survival gate.

rank_transform.scope: within each eligible signal-date complete-case U100 cross-section
rank_transform.method: average rank for ties, scaled to [0,1] as (rank-1)/(n-1), ascending raw value

date_quality_gate.rank_deficient_design: Exclude the date, record reason, and do not alter controls.
date_quality_gate.coverage_audit: For every date used, confirm date-specific mother traded symbols and broker observed-missing count under the PIT lineage contract.

primary_model.per_date_equation: RANK_FWD_H20_i,d = a_d + bB_d*RANK_BROKER_HHI_i,d + bM_d*RANK_MOM20_i,d + bR_d*RANK_REV5_i,d + bL_d*RANK_LIQ20_i,d + bF_d*RANK_AGG_FLOW5_i,d + error_i,d
primary_model.interpretation: Incremental cross-sectional rank association of broker concentration after the frozen stock-level controls and date-level common market conditions.

hac.estimator: Newey-West/HAC on the ordered daily bB_d series

temporal_stability.late: 2023-01-01 through latest mature H20 signal date
temporal_stability.rule: Run the identical frozen model with no retuning; report mean bB_d and sign for each period.
temporal_stability.year_by_year: Descriptive only; no year deletion or cherry-picking.

report_for_each_state: broker feature cross-sectional median and dispersion

secondary_horizon_diagnostics.model: Same rank model and controls with only the outcome horizon changed to the already-frozen horizon.
secondary_horizon_diagnostics.authority: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; no multiple-horizon winner selection and no rescue of H20.

frozen_null_baseline_carryover.execution_lock: signal after close -> next TWSE open; round-trip cost 40 bp; horizons 5/10/20/40/60; fail closed
frozen_null_baseline_carryover.current_stage_note: This preregistration intentionally defines no signed Broker Top-k portfolio because the concentration-return sign is unresolved. Therefore the null portfolio contract is inherited as a lock for any later signed challenger, not used to choose a sign after this result.

requirements: Primary H20 HAC 95% CI for B_BROKER excludes zero.
Primary H20 moving-block-bootstrap 95% CI for B_BROKER excludes zero.
Early and late mean bB_d have the same sign as full-sample B_BROKER.
INCREMENTAL_VALUE_ESTABLISHED_RECONSTRUC.meaning: Broker concentration contains stable incremental cross-sectional ranking information in the revision-aware retrospective reconstruction.

NO_STABLE_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_KILL.trigger: A valid primary H20 test fails any survival requirement because the CIs include zero or temporal sign stability fails.
NO_STABLE_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_KILL.rule: KILL this BROKER_GROSS_HHI_1D candidate. Do not rescue by changing sign, broker set, lookback, threshold, feature family or horizon.

DATA_OR_LINEAGE_INVALID_STOP.trigger: Required lineage, date coverage, frozen universe, state, complete-case or outcome-maturity checks fail.
DATA_OR_LINEAGE_INVALID_STOP.rule: No alpha conclusion. Repair only data/lineage implementation without inspecting or optimizing outcome results, then replay the same frozen preregistration.

negative_result_policy.significant_negative_beta: Counts as incremental information for this research question, not as permission to flip the historical strategy. A low-concentration trading hypothesis would require a new prospectively frozen test.

promotion_boundary.if_reconstruction_survives: Only a new prospective source-vintage preregistration using FORWARD_COLLECTED_VENDOR_SNAPSHOT may test a directional candidate. The retrospective reconstruction sample cannot be relabeled as confirmatory OOS.

basis: Exactly one primary broker feature is frozen.
Lookback, broker set, sign convention, universe, controls, outcome, primary horizon, inference and kill rule are fixed before HENGCE broker forward-return inspection.
Historical source-vintage limitation is explicit and caps any positive result at reconstruction-only authority.
preregistration_gate.authority_consequence: AFTER THIS ARTIFACT IS COMMITTED ATOMICALLY WITH THE PIT CONTRACT, THE FIRST AND ONLY FROZEN HISTORICAL HENGCE BROKER OUTCOME TEST MAY BE EXECUTED. NO TUNING IS AUTHORIZED.
